Such development may include providing fiscal, customer and statistical data and analysis to support various business cases to pursue. The role also assists in the analysis and tracking of Clean Technologies efforts and metrics, such as data from clean energy pilots. Analytical tasks may be highly structured based on previous analyses, or completely new, requiring substantial research, initiative, and collaboration skills to succeed. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of energy systems and the data behind them.

cond_0369.intro: We are looking for an Analyst to join our Clean Technologies team. In this role, you will work alongside colleagues to support research and development of Clean Technologies projects, including hydrogen, geothermal, renewable natural gas, and other decarbonization initiatives such as integrated gas and electric planning. This work involves coordinating with internal teams and external organizations to review existing policies, help develop new ones, and collect data from industry groups, clean energy organizations, and research associations. Support reporting and research needs within the Clean Technologies group, as needed.
Provide end user training and support on clean technologies related platforms to the Clean Technologies team and other internal audiences, as applicable.

Such development may include providing fiscal, customer and statistical data and analysis to support various business cases to pursue. The role also assists in the analysis and tracking of Clean Technologies efforts and metrics, such as data from clean energy pilots. Analytical tasks may be highly structured based on previous analyses, or completely new, requiring substantial research, initiative, and collaboration skills to succeed. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of energy systems and the data behind them.
